items.title: Chester Zardis Interview, 1970-02-14
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, now, what about those early bands? Like, did you ever hear Manuel Perez? ... [INTERVIEWEE] They're great bands.

ctx.x: Well, I don't think so. You know what I mean? It's different bands, but it's different ways, you know what I mean? And it's a fool like, you take a rock and roll player, you put him with a Dixieland band, well, he just, you know what I mean? It's just something different altogether. Yeah.
Well, now, what about those early bands? Like, did you ever hear Manuel Perez? Yeah, yeah, sure.
They're great bands. What sort of style did they play? Well, mostly Dixiel's.
